composite_DM_parameters.source: arXiv:1901.00075v2 (Finite-size dark matter); project's v0.6 KSFR scale m_rho ~ 30 MeV

relic_density_check.note: Freeze-in from SM bath (Irastorza et al. 2018, Coogan et al. 2019). Production rate scales as Gamma ~ epsilon^2 * m_rho * T_RH^3 / M_Pl. For epsilon ~ 10^-37, this requires very high reheating temperature T_RH > 10^15 GeV or non-standard cosmology.

verdict: At v0.7 MAP (epsilon=1.119e-37), the composite form factor F^2(q) gives an EVEN MORE EXTREME suppression than T78's 70 orders. For E_R >~ 10 keV (LZ regime), F^2 < 10^-300 (Gaussian) or F^2 < 10^-10 (dipole), so sigma_DM-nuc is effectively zero at any LZ sensitivity. Relic density: epsilon ~ 1.119e-37 falls in the freeze-in regime; this is consistent IF reheating temperature is high enough (T_RH > 10^15 GeV) or non-standard cosmology applies.
